# Dunslade Quarry - weighbridge tickets, June 2026

One row per weighed movement. IN loads are arriving deliveries to the quarry; OUT loads leave it for customers.

turns.prompt: Dunslade Quarry charges hauliers per outbound load. How many loads of Crushed rock left the quarry between 15 and 21 June 2026 inclusive? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer.
